title: Connectivity Synthesis Panel: compact network and cluster health summary for Private Console
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Design a compact, single-pane 'Connectivity Synthesis Panel' for the Private Console that surfaces per-tenant VPC connectivity status, cluster link health, recent upgrade events, and an actionable remediation strip. The panel is intended for tenant operators and SREs to quickly assess cross-cluster connectivity and decide on next steps (rollback, reroute, open incident). This ticket covers: low-fidelity flows, interactive mid-fi prototype, accessibility pass, and handoff assets for ENG and PM. Emphasis on density (information-per-row), graceful degradation when telemetry is partial, and explicit signal about upgrade-related transient failures.
acceptance_criteria: Panel renders in the Private Console Overview without adding more than 20% CPU to the list view (ENG verification)
Primary row shows tenant name, primary region, connectivity score (0-100), last successful handshake (ISO time), and dominant failure class with a color-coded badge
Clicking a tenant expands detail with cluster link map, recent upgrades timeline (last 7 days), top 3 impacted routes, and recommended remediation actions
Prototype tested with 6 SRE/design reviewers and at least two usability issues remediated (labels must show evidence)
Design tokens and spacing match console design system; components annotated for i18n and keyboard navigation
comments: 2025-02-18 - Maya Thompson: Initial ticket created after cross-functional kickoff. Attached low-fi wireframes and a short PRD draft. Raised question about whether remediation actions should be inline buttons or a flyout to reduce accidental rollouts.

2025-02-21 - Diego Ramirez: Mapped initial layout to existing console list components. Suggested swapping the 'last handshake' column for a small sparkline of error rate to surface trends. Flagged potential perf cost of rendering cluster-link map for every row.

2025-02-25 - Owen Park (SRE): Reviewed mid-fi prototype. Recommended adding a separate 'upgrade-in-progress' tag so transient failures can be correlated to rolling upgrades. Asked for an optional 'show only degraded' filter for large tenants.

2025-03-01 - Priya Singh (Accessibility): Ran keyboard walkthroughs. Found focus traps in the expanded details panel; suggested ARIA roles for the remediation strip and explicit skip links. Marked contrast issues for the failure-class badges.

2025-03-03 - Diego Ramirez: Incorporated ENG feedback—moved cluster-link map to lazy-loaded tile and replaced per-row sparklines with a hover-preview to reduce initial render cost. Updated prototype (mf-03) and requested engineering perf estimates.

2025-03-04 - Maya Thompson: Submitted design for review. Added annotated handoff with component tokens, variant states, and i18n notes. Requesting PM sign-off for prioritization in console-2025.03 cadence.
decisions: Keep remediation actions in a compact inline strip (primary action + overflow) to reduce context switches; advanced actions live in a flyout to prevent accidental rollouts
Cluster-link map will be lazy-loaded only when a tenant row is expanded; default row payload limited to lightweight metrics from the health index API
Connectivity score will be computed by backend (ENG) and surfaced as an integer 0-100; design applies three visual tiers (good/warily/bad) with color + icon
When telemetry is missing, we display 'Telemetry delayed' state with a secondary CTA to run a live connectivity probe
next_steps: PM to confirm priority and surface in roadmap (PM-741 dependency)
ENG to provide perf estimate for lazy-loading tile and health index API (ENG-4182)
Design to run moderated usability test with two SREs and two tenant operators next week (script attached in Confluence)
Accessibility remediation: fix focus trap and badge contrast, then re-run keyboard walkthrough
